Efx library shall not require initialization phase. A Library function may be called at the very first step of ECU initialization, e.g. even by the OS or EcuM, thus the library shall be ready.
Efx library shall not require a shutdown operation phase.
The Efx library shall be implemented in a way that the code can be shared among callers in different memory partitions.
Usage of macros should be avoided. The function should be de- clared as function or inline function. Macro #define should not be used.

A library function shall not call any BSW modules functions, e.g. the DET. A library function can call other library functions. Because a library function shall be re-entrant. But other BSW modules functions may not be re-entrant.
The library, written in C programming language, should conform to the MISRA C Standard. Please refer to SWS_BSW_00115 for more details.
Each AUTOSAR library Module implementation <library>*.c and <library>*.h shall map their code to memory sections using the AUTOSAR memory mapping mechanism.
All AUTOSAR library Modules should use the AUTOSAR data types (integers, boolean) instead of native C data types, unless this library is clearly identified to be compliant only with a platform.
All AUTOSAR library Modules should avoid direct use of compiler and platform specific keyword, unless this library is clearly identified to be compliant only with a platform. eg. #pragma, typeof etc.

The standardized common published parameters as required by SRS_BSW_00402 in the General Requirements on Basic Software Modules [REF] shall be published within the header file of this module and need to be provided in the BSW Module Description. The according module abbreviation can be found in the List of Basic Software Modules [REF].

The Ethernet Driver is using a zero-based index to abstract the access for upper software layers. The parameter EthCtrlIdx [ECUC_Eth_00007] within configuration corresponds to parameter CtrlIdx used in the API.

A buffer index (BufIdx) indentifies an Ethernet buffer processed by Ethernet Driver API functions. Each controller's buffers are identified by buffer indexes 0 to (n-1) where n is the number of buffers processed by the corresponding controller. Buffer indexes are valid within a tuple <CtrlIdx, BufIdx> only. A BufIdx uniquely identi- fies the buffer used for…
The Ethernet Driver module shall support pre-compile time, link time and post-build time configuration.
The header file Eth.h shall include a software and specification version number.
The Ethernet Driver module shall perform a consistency check be- tween code files and header files based on pre-process-checking the version numbers of related code files and header files.
In case development error detection is enabled for the Ethernet Driver module: The Ethernet Driver module shall check API parameters for validity and report detected errors to the DET.
None of the Ethernet Driver module header files shall define global variables.

The Ethernet Driver module shall provide an XML file that con- tains the data, which is required for the SW identification (it shall contain the vendor identification, module ID and software version information), configuration and integra- tion process. This file should describe vendor specific configuration parameters as well as it should contain recommend…
The configuration of the Ethernet Driver module shall be calcu- lated at ECU configuration time. None of the communication parameters shall be cal- culated at runtime.
The start address of post-build time configuration data shall be passed during module initialization.
